# Tables

| Name | Role |
|------|------|
| Ada  | Maths |
| Alan | Logic |

Alignment follows the delimiter row.

| Left | Centre | Right | Default |
|:-----|:------:|------:|---------|
| a    | b      | c     | d       |
| 12   | 3456   | 78    | 9       |

Cells wrap onto several lines when the column is narrow.

| Topic | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| Wrapping | This sentence is long enough that it has to wrap onto a second and a third line once the column gets narrow. |
| Styling | Cells keep **bold**, *italic*, `code` and [links](https://example.com). |
